title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that the mean free path is inversely proportional to temperature, lambda_ee ∝ 1/T.

title: Mean Free Path Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain that the mean free path is long due to the effective number density of electrons near the Fermi surface being low.

title: Temperature Dependence
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide a qualitative argument that as temperature increases, more electrons are excited, leading to more collisions.

title: Effective Density Relation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the relationship n_eff = nkT/epsilon_F to support their explanation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid incorrectly stating that the mean free path increases with temperature, which is a common misconception.
